mentions.name: Rouler
mentions.description: VPN split tunneling application for Windows that provides per-app and per-service connection steering, similar to IP rules on Linux. Built entirely in Rust, including the kernel driver; v1.0 has been released, with folder and Windows Store support planned next.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've just released v1.0 of Rouler which is VPN split tunneling for windows. Think IP rules for Linux, but with per-app/service connection steering. The whole app is built in Rust, including the kernel driver.
